constraints: Draft only from the sourced facts (CITY-01, COST-01, PHOTO-01, CITY-02, COST-02) and cite their source IDs. CITY-02 supersedes CITY-01 on the public opening, now Monday, December 14, at 10 a.m. COST-02 supersedes COST-01 on the cost, now $2.6 million. Put the public opening date and time in the web brief and newsletter. Put the cost in the web brief only. The caption should identify what the photo actually shows and include the credit. Keep the newsletter under 70 words. Only an editor instruction with an ED source ID can approve a draft for publication. Approval applies to the exact version reviewed. A factual change invalidates approval for drafts affected by that change. Restoring a previously approved fact does not restore an invalidated approval. Keep prior approvals and drafts in the history. Track publication separately from approval. No item has been published. After creating the three drafts and the release checklist, wait for the next update.
objective: Build and maintain a fictional Milwaukee magazine publication packet for the Cedar Street pedestrian bridge opening, in one ongoing project with three separately reviewable drafts (web brief, photo caption, newsletter blurb) and a release checklist showing each item's current version, source IDs, approval status, and whether it can be published.
output_format: Three separately labelled, versioned drafts (web brief, photo caption, newsletter blurb under 70 words), plus a release checklist giving each item's current version, source IDs, approval status and whether it can be published, with history kept
